body:
## IMPL-UNITGREEN-001: the unit suite green on both lab hosts (BDPv4: 0 failed, 0 skipped)

Operator, 2026-10-19: "BDPv4 requires all unit tests be green." and "There should be ZERO platform specific UNIT tests.  If it depends on the environment, it's an integration test." Plan: `docs/plans/2026-10-19-unit-suite-green.md` (approved 2026-10-19 14:50; amendments in sections 7 to 9, 11 and 17 to 27; execution record in sections 10, 12 and 14 to 27; decisions in section 13; D-B in 27.21 as amended by 27.22 to 27.29). Handoff: `docs/plans/2026-10-30-unit-suite-green-handoff.md` (its top section supersedes the rest).

Ready for review since 2026-11-03 09:59:32 local: the PR left draft then, by the shared sharpninja account, before the operator's 13:11 ruling "HV was to come after PR87 was  ready for review.", and it has had no convert_to_draft since, so it stayed ready while slices W to Z3 and slice Z3 part 3 changed code (plan 27.24, 27.28 and 27.29). Every gate is now green at the last code head, with no code pending (2026-10-21: "If it needs code, it's not ready for HV."). Round 12 (Codex CLI, gpt-6-astra, max effort, on the merged OMARCHY worktree only) must still return AGREE at 98/98 before the merge. No done state is claimed: every new or changed criterion is unsatisfied and all 46 tasks of IMPL-UNITGREEN-001 are unchecked.

### Commits (over develop; this branch's base was `3da2db93`, and develop `9b099716` is merged in docs only)

Through round 8b (plan sections 1 to 25):

- `cbc74e82`: System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and Pkcs pinned to the advisory-patched 10.0.13 (TR-MCP-QUALITY-001 ac-21).
- `28bf0b22`, `de581353`: canonical workspace-key tests, provider traits, and the host-aware `WorkspaceIdentityPath.ToNativePath` overload (FR, TR and TEST-MCP-PATHNORM-001; additive public API).
- `a4c358ef`: narrowing to leave PLAN-C4MODEL-001's fixes to that effort (superseded by `11681680`).
- `b2319488`: the HostileReviewWorker startup test no longer depends on Event Log write access (TR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003).
- `11681680`: takeover of PLAN-C4MODEL-001's unit-suite code and Linux provider provisioning (TR-MCP-NUKE-018), blob-identical to `c2125c42`, by operator decision.
- `8c2b83ab`: host-scoped MigrationIntegrationTests lane (TR-MCP-NUKE-019).
- `8a617334`: merge of develop with PR 86.
- `b2bd50b3`: platform-dependent tests classified as integration tests, with the unit-suite guard and a strengthened skip guard. Its first guard run, `unit-green-guard-mock-20261019T1720`, was red (4692 results, 1 failed, 16 not executed); see plan section 10.
- `4f668b76`: the plan and the PR 82 handoff correction.
- `59249260`: the interactive desktop-spawner case fails loudly as a Windows integration test.
- `69d8f3f5`: amendment H1, under which the Windows integration lane refuses a non-interactive session before any test.
- `12746834`: the invalid-handle final-path case runs only on Windows, without a silent return.
- `83417029`, `6b4295b7`: docs only (the plan as built, the code-head receipts, the 19:41 decisions).
- `49cfec92`: hostile validation round 1, findings F3 and F5 (one skip definition for both guards; interpolation holes kept as code).
- `b4ad42aa`: round 1 finding F2 (36 native-boundary and tracked-file cases move to Integration, assertions unchanged).
- `a94579db`: docs only (the round 1 receipts and record, the round 2 gate receipts).
- `45a3197c`: round 2 finding R2-F2. `UnitSuitePlatformScanner` reads Roslyn syntax trees instead of regex lines; the five central Roslyn pins move from 5.3.0 to 5.9.0 (operator: "Use the latest Roslyn tools!").
- `27c43bcc`: round 2 finding R2-F1. One repository-root locator, `tests/Shared/TestRepositoryRoot.cs`, refuses outside `Category=Integration` (operator: "Looks like an opportunity to DRY"); 34 locator copies delegate to it; the tests it refused, plus link-creating and host-state tests, move to Integration with assertions unchanged; Repl.Core.Tests and QBAgent.Tests join MigrationIntegrationTests.
- `538d0ccf`: the user-profile scan fix (operator: "Fix scans in PR 87 (Recommended)"; this PR carries the fix for `triage-report-b0e41c36f93c4c91b1bf2524eb579ef8`). `DirectoryTreeWalker` (QBrainAi.Services) serves the marker plugin-cache scan and the session-log history scan: no directory link or other reparse point is followed, and a directory whose listing throws an IO or access error is skipped. The 12 import-path tests are tagged Integration.
- `56d14d7c`: a race in the new hermetic-profile check, found by the pre-HV what-if pass, fixed.
- `6042dbb3`, `0210244d`, `68fa7b39`: the LocalDB flake (operator: "Fix the flake in PR 87 (Recommended)", then "Serialize SQL Server tests (Recommended)"): one LocalDB default with a 120 s connect timeout, and the four classes that open LocalDB in one collection defined with `DisableParallelization = true`.
- `6ea425ab`: the Windows lane's lost results (operator: "Diagnose the loss in PR 87"): pg_ctl start and stop run with `-s`, so pg_ctl no longer writes into the xUnit v3 message stream.
- `395b4cd8`, `6b89998f`, `64fc4b14`: docs only (the round 2 HV receipts, the round 3 gate receipts and plan record, the round 3 pre-launch records).
- `e0b078c8`: pre-HV problem R3-P3 (operator: "Fold R3-P3 in first"): a plugin version file that exists but cannot be read no longer fails the marker.
- `0996a116`: docs only, the hostile validation round 3 receipts as received.
- `801e6862`: round 3 findings R3-F1 and R3-F2 (operator: "Structural fix, round 4 (Recommended)"). One source seam, `AgentPluginVersionSources`, holds every input marker plugin-version resolution reads; the unit-test assembly fixture installs test-owned sources and resolution tests pass explicit sources.
- `c31c2918`: docs only, round 3 finding R3-F4.
- `26fc8348`: the two red results at `801e6862`. `HandoffDurabilityTests` gives each context its own connection to one temporary database file (operator: "Fix the race in PR 87 (Recommended)"; `triage-report-9b96ada18d72483dad2a3113e455c01b`, closed by this PR); the process sources and sibling rule moved back into `MarkerFileService`, so the `Path.GetFullPath` ratchet (TR-MCP-FED-PATH-001) passes again.
- `50b58ce5`: docs only, the round 4 run receipts through `26fc8348`.
- `97b78114`: the siblings of the race class, `HandoffAuditDefectTests` and `MemoryS1Harness`, get the same fix (operator: "Extend fix, then round 4 (Recommended)").
- `b0db5b09`, `094e47f4`: docs only (round 4 records and receipts).
- `8c254695`: round 4 finding R4-F3. The memory harness binding cites FR-MCP-MEMORY-002, TR-MCP-MEMORY-002 and TEST-MCP-MEMORY-002, present and mapped. Documentation comment only.
- `ccc78b7a`: round 4 finding R4-F1, as the operator decided (see "Scanner: operator override"). Documentation comments only.
- `3a9f8ff4`, `5b818847`: docs only (round 5 run receipts and plan section 18).
- `810ee8aa`: `McpDatabaseEncryptionTransitionCommandTests.TryParse_UsesEnvironmentInstance_WhenCliInstanceIsOmitted` is `Category=Integration` and clears `QBRAINAI_INSTANCE` for its duration; assertions unchanged; test-only.
- `8b7a49ea`, `780b6513`, `c3625a64`: docs only (round 5 records and receipts).
- `9933796c`: round 5 finding R5-F1 (operator: "Fix both, strengthen ACs"). `DirectoryTreeWalker.IsReachable` requires the scan root and every folder between the profile or home and it to be a directory that is not a link. Mock gate `ug-r6-reach-mockgate-1` 4536/0/0 before any production change.
- `c8418301`: round 5 finding R5-F2 and the environment sweep (operator: "Approve, strengthen AC-006/008 (Recommended)"), test-only. 13 unit tests that read or write the process environment move to `Category=Integration` with every variable controlled and restored; the writers run in one serialized collection (`ProcessEnvironmentCollection`).
- `44e9d810`, `3ce97b3e`, `3a607fb1`: docs only (round 6 records and receipts).
- `6a87791d`, `04841148`: round 6 findings R6-F1 and R6-F2 (operator: "Strengthen AC, move 14 (Recommended)"), test-only: the 14 CLI temp-folder tests run inside `TestSupport/CliTempVariables`; absent requirement ids on lines this branch adds are labeled historical.
- `c31f36d8`, `55c1400c`, `8b97aa4b`, `96b81bef`: docs only (round 7 records and receipts).
- `f5cda3c1`: round 7 finding R7-F1 (operator: "Fix source, strengthen AC (Recommended)"), a production fix: `ReplCommandTimeout` is the one parse rule for the two REPL timeout variables.
- `7ab3c1c4`, `845f323b`: the Windows junction flake (operator: "Fix flake, strengthen AC (Recommended)"), test-only: `TestSupport/WindowsJunction`.
- `ccd9e91f`: the REPL timeout rule at its two call sites through `ReplCommandTimeout.Read` and an internal `ReadVariable` seam.
- `43cb62a7`, `868bbb57`, `2175d827`: docs only (round 8 records; the stopped round 8's receipts as received).
- `8c651f13`, `d5a23364`, `6667c405`, `2f679213`, `4fab4424`, `3e487b6b`: plan section 22 (slices A, B, C), the REPL integration defects, streamed provisioning downloads, and the marker walk cases as unit tests over an in-memory file system.
- `751e34e4`, `433ce191`, `4634c73c`, `d43c1d12`, `fbc2da86`, `a69edb61`: docs, documentation comments, and the docs-only merge of develop `9b099716` (99 files, all under `docs/`).
- `a78640ba`: pre-HV problem R8b-P18, documentation comment only; the code head round 8b reviewed.
- `2b0f65d8`, `366238a2`, `a9d6a8d7`, `332e0d31`, `00399174`: docs only (round 8b records, its three attempts, and the round 8b receipts as received, DISAGREE 96/95).

Round 9 (plan sections 26 and 27 to 27.21):

- `0dd224da`, `fb19eeab`: docs only (the handoff at the 2026-10-30 pause).
- `765490a9` (committed by Codex, gpt-6.1-sol; Claude wrote slices D to H, K and L, and Codex wrote I, J, M, N and O): the round 8b fixes of plan section 26 (slice D, the explicit-baseline environment delta for R8B-F1; slice E, the owned-instance environment for R8B-F3; slice F, the two Support.Mcp.IntegrationTests classes in the lane for R8B-F2; slice G and the sibling sweep), slice H (the FR-MCP-QBOPENAI-001 ac-5/ac-6 port, operator: "Port ac-5/ac-6 into PR 87") and the holistic-review slices I to O (27.2 to 27.16), each criterion first, contract and mock gate before the code it binds. 470 paths, 247 outside `docs/`. The section 26, H, K and L runs and four of Codex's runs had no durable receipt until plan 27.21 wrote them retrospectively from each run's own files.
- `679eb788` (Codex): docs and run evidence (the handoff, the incomplete Linux lane receipt and its five TRX), plus the two lane-rewritten benchmark files (restored in `611a5dc5`).
- `611a5dc5`: slices Q (Nuke target TestGroups, TR-MCP-NUKE-020 AC-1 to AC-5), R (owned-instance provider key, FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001 ac-4; the GitHubCliService GetFullPath ratchet) and P (stored requirement times, FR-MCP-040 ac-1), the traceability reconciliation, the benchmark files restored to develop. 63 paths.
- `62c5882d`: dated XML change logs per MEMORY-FACT-008 on every member and test class slices Q, R and P changed (documentation only), and the final2 receipts. 38 paths.
- `23955af0`: docs only (plan 27.20, the gates at `62c5882d`, the HV TRX set at `62c5882d`, now history).
- `878c366f`: slice S (plan 27.21), test and test-support only: `TemporaryInstanceChecks.CheckTestOutputFolder` (FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001, the criterion on generated test artifacts); the two memory-bench stub cases write to a checked temporary folder, so a lane run no longer rewrites `docs/benchmarks/results`; the offset-less stored-time row for FR-MCP-040 ac-1 ("UTC"). The code head round 9 reviewed.
- `46270931`, `e3eb8369`, `a9825017`: docs only (the gates and HV TRX evidence at `878c366f`, plan 27.21, the retrospective receipts, the round 9 prelaunch records, and the round 9 receipts as received, DISAGREE 95/94).

Round 10 (plan 27.22):

- `6082b116`: slice T, the round 9 findings (operator: "Strengthen 5 ACs, fix all 8 (Recommended)"). `TestGroupExecution.CheckClasses` counts a class only through an executed result joined to its definition by test id (R9-F1, TR-MCP-NUKE-020 AC-5); `TemporaryInstanceChecks.CheckHealthAnswer` compares the JSON nonce field with the whole nonce (R9-F2, FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001 ac-12); the generated-artifact and owned-root checks compare path segments under the path's own syntax (R9-F3 and its sibling, the criterion on generated test artifacts and ac-4); `RequirementStoredTimestamp.Read` never fills a missing date or year from the clock (R9-F4, FR-MCP-040 ac-1); one model rule, `build/QuadBrainOllamaModel.cs`, used by InstallOllama and the QuadBrain cases (R9-F5, TR-MCP-NUKE-016 AC-001); XML documentation on the 38 undocumented members of slices Q, R, P and S (R9-F8). The code head round 10 reviewed.
- `03df5a6a`, `4e4a227a`: docs only (the gates and HV TRX evidence at `6082b116`, plan 27.22, the round 10 prelaunch records, and the round 10 receipts as received, DISAGREE 96/95).

Round 11 (plan 27.23), fixed between rounds under the operator's "don't gate on me between rounds":

- `2e121015`: slice U, the round 10 findings. `RequirementStoredTimestamp.Read` accepts only exact formats that state the year, the month and the day (R10-F1, FR-MCP-040 ac-1); `TemporaryInstanceChecks` parses an explicit path root (the POSIX root, a drive letter, or a UNC server and share with either separator) and its containment and equality require the same root (R10-F2, FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001 ac-4 and the criterion on generated test artifacts); a test-owned `ScriptedClock` feeds the session-state fake and the auth stub, and six unit cases assert exact scripted times with no sleep (R10-F3, TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006). Each criterion first through the plugin, contracts and wrong implementations, mock gate `ug-r11-mockgate-u-1`, binding `ug-r11-binding-u-1`. 16 paths.
- `cb174ac8`: slice V, the R10-F3 siblings my first sweep missed and stale slice U documentation, found in the holistic read before round 11. TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 appended first (every recorded time a unit test checks, including service-stamped creation and update times). `GraphRagService` takes an optional `TimeProvider` and `MemoryService` gains a constructor that takes one (the system clock otherwise); `GraphRagEntityCrudTests` (two cases) and `MemoryModelTests.Timestamps_CreateAndUpdate` assert exact scripted times through the new `StampedTimeContractTests` with no live-clock range and no sleep; two `AuthRotationTests` cases and `GraphRagEntityStorageTests.PersistsEntityWithAllFields` use fixed instants; the `TemporaryInstanceChecks` summaries state the slice U root rule and no longer cite the removed `SegmentComparison` (documentation only). Mock gate `ug-r11-mockgate-v-1`, binding `ug-r11-binding-v-1`, sweep receipt `ug-r11-clock-sweep.txt` (history since slice W). 12 paths.
- `1f51d4b2`: slice W, found in the holistic read before round 11: TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 also says a unit test asserts no wall-clock bound, which my slice V record had read only against its recorded-time sentence. AC-006 appended first (an assertion whose outcome depends on how much real time passes is an integration test; a hang-guard timeout is not a wall-clock bound). Tests only: `HandoffDurabilityTests.ProcessingLease_RenewsAndFencesTerminalUpdates` waits for the renewed lease expiry and asserts it exactly instead of sleeping 250 ms and asserting "later"; `QBAgentHeartbeatOverlayTests.RunAsync_Heartbeat_RotatesGlyphWithoutStillWorkingLines` and `SessionLogFileWatcherTests.WhenFileCreatedThenWatcherTriggersImport` are `Category=Integration`, assertions unchanged. Binding `ug-r11-binding-w-1`; timing sweep receipt `ug-r11-timing-sweep.txt` (every timer-bounded wait and recorded-time comparison in the unit projects, mapped to the unit TRX and classified). 3 paths.
- `142a93f0`: docs only (the gates and HV TRX evidence at `1f51d4b2`, plan 27.23, the receipts of slices U, V and W, the round 11 prelaunch records).

Round 12 (plan 27.24 to 27.29):

- Round 11 stopped without a verdict at 12:31:31 on the reviewer's account usage limit; it is not evidence. Before stopping, it stated three findings, R11-F1 to R11-F3.
- `11406fdf`: slice X, those three findings, each verified against source, and their siblings. The FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001 generated-artifact criterion and TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 were appended first.
  - `TemporaryInstanceChecks.CheckTestOutputFolder` now refuses a folder in the other path syntax than the checkout, a Windows device path (`\\?\`, `\\.\`, `\??\`) and a Windows segment that ends in a dot or a space or holds a colon (R11-F1 and its siblings).
  - `StubMarkerFileReaderTests.WatchAsync_SimulatesMarkerFileChange_InvokesCallback` no longer arms a 100 ms cancellation that races the callback (R11-F2).
  - `SessionLogFileWatcherTests` labels TR-PLANNED-CORE-013 historical (R11-F3).
  - Mock gate `ug-r11x-mockgate-1`, binding `ug-r11x-binding-1`. 4 paths. I wrote it while HV was paused, against the operator's 2026-10-21 instruction; he then chose to keep it, finish its gates, mark the PR ready and run HV.
- The holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent, profile 7.5): 33 findings in the round 12 records (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings.md`). Two change criteria; the operator chose "Strengthen + margin (Recommended)" and "Strengthen + fix (Recommended)" (16:35:40). The rest are corrected in the records or declared (plan 27.25).
- `ec58cf4a`: slice Y. TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 (the hang-guard sentence governs; a hang guard is at least 100 times the awaited step's delay) and the FR-MCP-TESTRESOURCE-001 generated-artifact criterion (UNC server and share names held to the segment alias rule) were appended first.
  - `CheckTestOutputFolder` refuses a UNC folder whose server or share name ends in a dot or a space or holds a colon; `PathIdentity.Parse` uses the class's one separator test (the duplicate `IsSeparator` is removed; `Split` kept its own copy of the set until slice Z).
  - `TodoWorkflowTests.BufferedPromptHelpers_PreserveCallerCancellation` and `QBAgentHeartbeatOverlayTests.RunAsync_RunnerThrows_HidesGlyph` raise their hang guards to 10 s, at least 100 times the delay they wait on.
  - Dated change-log entries correct the slice X entries that named "don't gate on me between rounds" as their authority.
  - Mock gate `ug-r12y-mockgate-1`, binding `ug-r12y-binding-1`. 5 paths. The compile receipts of slice Y were written retrospectively, after the binding.
- The second holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent): 22 findings (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings-2.md`). C1: my slice Y margin pass missed unit cases whose awaited step races a timer. No criterion changed; the rest are corrected in the records or declared (plan 27.26).
- `a4e8d45f`: slice Z, from C1 and its sibling sweep (a v2 timing finder that sees multi-line timer calls, SpinUntil bounds and nested fakes, a list of the durations unit tests configure, and the production waits on the awaited path read against source).
  - Six hang guards raised to 100 times the delay of the step each races, measured then as the single largest timer on the step (under the sum AC-006 has stated since 2026-11-04 12:20:22, three of them were 94 and 95 times, and slice Z2 raised them): two `TurnTransactionCoordinatorTests` cases (30 s to 100 s over the 1 s commit timeout), `HandoffDurabilityTests.SaveRunAfterTodo_CompensationTimeout_DoesNotReportCreatedFromMemory` (3 s to 5 s over the 50 ms compensation timeout), `BugTriage139SixteenthSqliteConsumerTests.OpenAsync_ResultWithheldUntilThreadExit_WorkerRemainsObservable` (5 s to 10 s over a 100 ms scripted wait), two `SqliteBoundedOpenFourteenthTests` cases (5 s to 25 s over the opener's 250 ms native cleanup deadline).
  - `TemporaryInstanceChecks` states its separator set once (`PathSeparators`).
  - Compile `ug-r12z-compile-1` with a receipt written when the run ended; binding `ug-r12z-binding-1` (151/0/0). 5 paths.
- The third holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent): 25 findings, none below the margin under the reading the records used (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings-3.md`). Its d3: TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 did not say how the awaited step's delay is measured. The operator answered "Fix it" (2026-11-04), which I read as the recommended "Strengthen + headroom"; AC-006 was appended first (the delay is the sum of every real or scripted delay on the step's path, read from the sources, never a measured run time). The record findings are corrected or declared (plan 27.27).
- `121992b3`: slice Z2, the three bounds below 100 times under that sum, test-only, assertions unchanged.
  - The five `HandoffDurabilityTests` `WaitUntilAsync` callers 5 s to 10 s (over the 50 ms heartbeat poll and the helper's 10 ms poll).
  - Two `SqliteBoundedOpenFourteenthTests` cancelled-open bounds 25 s to 30 s (over the 250 ms cleanup deadline; I counted 265 ms with the 10 ms loop and the 5 ms exit poll, but the open throws at the deadline without waiting for the poll, so 30 s is 120 times; declared in 27.28).
  - The `BugTriage139SixteenthSqliteConsumerTests.OpenAsync_ResultWithheldUntilThreadExit_WorkerRemainsObservable` open timeout 10 s to 15 s (over the 100 ms wait and the 5 ms exit poll).
  - Compile `ug-r12z2-compile-1` with a receipt written when the run ended; binding `ug-r12z2-binding-1` (36/0/0). 3 paths. Six more bounds (seven cases) are exactly 100 times the sum; this commit's message says five (declared in 27.28).
- The fourth holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent; its first launch was stopped by the operator's system update and reported nothing): 28 findings (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings-4.md`). Its g1: a SQLite busy retry (150 ms in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.0) can land on a polled path. The operator answered "Strengthen: include them"; AC-006 was appended first (a wait that happens only under a condition the step can meet counts once for each poll on the path). Its c1: the PR left draft on 2026-11-03 at 09:59:32, not after the 13:11 ruling as my records said. The record findings are corrected or declared (plan 27.28).
- The redeploy (operator, 2026-11-04: "redeploy the systemd service with current worktree code using nuke."), through the Nuke target `UpdateService` and pkexec. The first run failed in the unit reader before any service change; the second stopped the unit and gave up on health while the server was still starting, and its failure path restored a unit file naming the legacy apphost the replacement had removed, so the unit could not start; the server was down from about 16:18:31 to 16:51:06 until I retargeted the unit and started it outside the target at the operator's choice ("Start now, fix target after (Recommended)"); the third ran end to end at `4920a8ea`. TR-MCP-SERVICEUPDATE-001 gained two criteria first (repeated-properties, startup-health-wait).
- `b3f26862`: slice Z3, part 1. `LinuxServiceHelper.GetUnit` reads systemd `show` output that repeats a property on separate lines (systemd 262 prints one `EnvironmentFiles=` line per file) through `ParseUnitProperties` (contract `ServiceUnitPropertiesContractTests`, mock gate `ug-r12z3-mockgate-1`, 8/0/0, before the change). The five `HandoffDurabilityTests` `WaitUntilAsync` callers 10 s to 36 s, 100 times the 360 ms renewal path with one busy retry per poll. The `TodoWorkflowTests.CreateWorkflow` workspace path is a generic drive-rooted path (the plan 27.7 scrub). Compile `ug-r12z3-compile-1`; bindings `ug-r12z3-binding-1` (98/0/0) and `-2` (124/0/0). 5 paths.
- `4920a8ea`: slice Z3, part 2. `UpdateLinuxService` waits through `LinuxServiceHelper.WaitForStartupHealth` (120 probes 5 s apart, failing at once when the unit leaves the active state) before its unchanged final health check (contract `ServiceStartupHealthContractTests` over scripted unit state, probe and sleep, mock gate `ug-r12z3-mockgate-2`, 7/0/0, before the change). Compile `ug-r12z3-compile-2`; binding `ug-r12z3-binding-3` (98/0/0). 4 paths. The wait counts probes, not an elapsed 10 minutes, and its criterion startup-health-wait stays out of D-B (see Open and declared).
- The fifth holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent): 24 findings (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings-5.md`). Its g1: the startup health wait of `4920a8ea` does not meet startup-health-wait as stored (it counts 120 probes rather than an elapsed time; any state other than active, or a failing state read, ends it; no test binds the constants or the call; the bound is stated as built under Open and declared). Its d3: a failed update after the replacement restored a unit file naming the removed legacy apphost. Its d4: the Windows update keeps its 18 s health window. The operator answered (2026-11-04 19:16:54) "Keep, out of D-B", "Strengthen + fix in Z3 (Recommended)" and "Declare, out of scope". The record findings are corrected or declared (plan 27.29).
- `52e6d627`: slice Z3, part 3, for d3. TR-MCP-SERVICEUPDATE-001 criterion failed-update-startable was appended first (19:26:23). `LinuxServiceHelper.Update` now, when an update fails after the replacement completed, retargets a unit file or drop-in that names the legacy apphost after the restore and reloads systemd only when a file changed; `RetargetLegacyExecStart` returns whether it changed a file (contract `ServiceRecoveryContractTests`, 6 rows and six wrong recoveries, the old restore-only path first; mock gate `ug-r12z3c-mockgate-1`, 8/0/0, before the change). Compile `ug-r12z3c-compile-1`; binding `ug-r12z3c-binding-1` (97/0/0). 3 paths. The last code, test or build change.
- The sixth holistic read before round 12 (a read-only subagent): 24 findings (`docs/receipts/hv/unitgreen-r12-prelaunch.holistic-findings-6.md`). Its g1: the recovery's retarget replaces the legacy name everywhere in the unit files, as the success path always has, and no row covers a non-ExecStart line, two legacy drop-ins, an overridden legacy fragment or a unit at systemd's start limit. Its g2: a failing retarget or reload after a completed restore is reported as a restoration failure, and no row covers it. Its f1: the retrospective receipt of the `b3f26862` Linux lane named the head at its write time. The operator answered (2026-11-05 00:12:32) "Declare, keep in D-B" and "Declare", so no code changed after `52e6d627`; the record findings are corrected or declared (plan 27.29).
- Docs only after it: `3fe29d1f` (the gates and HV TRX evidence at `52e6d627`, plan 27.24 to 27.29, the round 11 receipts as received, the six holistic reads, the receipts of slices X to Z3 and the round 12 prelaunch records; 625 paths, all under `docs/`). `git diff --name-only 52e6d627..HEAD` lists only `docs/` paths (D-A).
